__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore)
__broaden__.αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’)
__broaden__.βάλλομεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; pres. 1 pl., in tmesis with ἀμφί (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν): ’we threw around, embraced’ · also ’shoot, let fly’ (missiles); impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐβάλλομεν), no tmesis: ’we shot’
__broaden__.βῆμεν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἔβημεν): ’we went, we embarked’ · also ’we stepped out’, in tmesis with ἐκ (ἐκ … βῆμεν = ἐξέβημεν ’we disembarked’)
__broaden__.δειπνήσειαν: δειπνέω — dine, take a meal; aor. opt. 3 pl., in a wish: ’might they dine’ · also in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that they might dine’
__broaden__.διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’)
__broaden__.δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’ · also of Dawn: Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’
__broaden__.εἴδομεν: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel (= Attic εἰδῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us know, let us find out’ · also ὁράω — see; aor. 1 pl. εἴδομεν, augmented (the same form in Attic; εἶδον): indicative ’we saw’
__broaden__.εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in an indirect question: ’(who) they might be’ · also with κε, potential: ’would be’ (κ’ … εἶεν)
__broaden__.κατέδυ: δύω — sink, enter, go down into; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augmented, in tmesis (κατά … ἔδυ = κατέδυ): ’went down into’ · also without tmesis, of the sun: ’set, went down’ (ἠέλιος κατέδυ)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’)

__broaden__.οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with the subject: ’standing alone’ (ὅ τε φαίνεται οἶον ’which appears alone’)
__broaden__.πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’
__broaden__.χρεὼ: χρεώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. (indeclinable), impersonal with γίγνεται: ’a need arises’ · also with ἐστιν + gen.: ’there is need (of)’ (οὐ χρεὼ πείσματός ἐστιν ’there is no need of a cable’)
__broaden__.ἀνάψαι: ἀνάπτω — fasten on, attach; aor. inf.: ’to fasten (blame) on’ · also ’fasten, make fast (a cable)’: aor. inf. (πρυμνήσι’ ἀνάψαι ’to make the stern-cables fast’)

__broaden__.ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also masc. gen. sg., with the masc. adjective πολιοῖο: ’of the grey sea’ (ἁλὸς πολιοῖο)
__broaden__.ὑψηλόν: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), agreeing with σπέος: ’(a cave) high’
__broaden__.μεῖναι: μένω — stay, wait; aor. inf., standing as an instruction: ’wait’ · also infinitive after χρεώ, ’to wait’ (οὐ χρεὼ … ἀλλ’ … μεῖναι ’no need … but to wait’)
